problem: Opaque manifest evidence does not enforce referenced source bytes transitively; prior validation required manual nested checks.
background: UADOS has stable evidence snapshots, live gates, history audits and export/rebuild. Preserve schema1, protocols and signed T7 checkpoint boundary.
alternatives: Flatten dependencies into top-level evidence only
Add opt-in bounded manifest closure metadata through existing evidence hooks
decision: Use strict version1 reserved-suffix manifests with exact hash/byte entries, bounded cycle-safe closure and optional dependency metadata on root evidence records.
impact: Existing plan/review/run/audit/export paths enforce captured dependency bytes; singular experiment config retains closure; ordinary and old evidence remains unchanged.
risk: Local hashes and project lock do not prove authenticity or protect arbitrary OS writers; metadata needs matching newer runtime and graph size limits; failed commits can leave harmless orphan snapshot objects.
validation: Nested/shared graph snapshots, strict malformed/path/size/cycle/conflict refusal, zero partial events, leaf mutation workflow gates, history corruption and export/rebuild retention, full91regression and independent plan/result debate.
